_doc: The AI tester fleet's selector map for the office (ma-platform ADR 0134 addendum; ma-platform tests/fleet-mcp, src/domain/office.ts and office-apps.ts, read it). Every sel is from this app's own markup. A change to an element a key names updates its key here in the same commit. Keys by area, each group's as one block: bible.* and office.* are fleet group G4's (checked by tests/e2e/fleet-map.shell.spec.ts, and the Bible's own keys on its real view by apps/bible/view/tests/fleet-map.bible.spec.ts); apps.*, maia.*, notebook.*, files.* and commons.* are G5's (checked by tests/e2e/fleet-map-apps.shell.spec.ts). The routes office (G4's) and apps (G5's) are both the office at /.

bible.frame.note: the Bible's sandboxed view (deskapps/host/AppView.tsx), in its window or its open tile; the bible.* keys below are inside it

bible.ready.note: the view's root once it reads (data-state ready)
bible.ready.reason: inside the real Bible view (apps/bible/view), which the shell harness's mock desk doesn't serve (src/desk/mockDeskApps.ts has a stand-in); checked in apps/bible/view/tests/fleet-map.bible.spec.ts

bible.error.note: the view's root when its app isn't answering
bible.error.reason: inside the real Bible view, and only when its service doesn't answer; checked in apps/bible/view/tests/fleet-map.bible.spec.ts

bible.column.reason: inside the real Bible view (apps/bible/view), which the shell harness's mock desk doesn't serve (src/desk/mockDeskApps.ts has a stand-in); checked in apps/bible/view/tests/fleet-map.bible.spec.ts

bible.chapter.note: the chapter's heading, such as John 3
bible.chapter.reason: inside the real Bible view (apps/bible/view), which the shell harness's mock desk doesn't serve (src/desk/mockDeskApps.ts has a stand-in); checked in apps/bible/view/tests/fleet-map.bible.spec.ts

bible.ref.note: Go to, in the top bar
bible.ref.reason: inside the real Bible view; checked in apps/bible/view/tests/fleet-map.bible.spec.ts

bible.goto.reason: inside the real Bible view, open only after bible.ref; checked in apps/bible/view/tests/fleet-map.bible.spec.ts

bible.goto.field.note: the reference field in Go to (Enter goes)
bible.goto.field.reason: inside the real Bible view, open only after bible.ref; checked in apps/bible/view/tests/fleet-map.bible.spec.ts

bible.goto.error.note: Go to's line for a reference it can't find
bible.goto.error.reason: inside the real Bible view, shown only for a bad reference; checked in apps/bible/view/tests/fleet-map.bible.spec.ts

bible.translation.note: the translation button; its name is Translation, <abbreviation>
bible.translation.reason: inside the real Bible view; checked in apps/bible/view/tests/fleet-map.bible.spec.ts

bible.translations.reason: inside the real Bible view, open only after bible.translation; checked in apps/bible/view/tests/fleet-map.bible.spec.ts

bible.translation.pick.note: one row per translation (a list); its text is the name, then <abbreviation>, <edition>
bible.translation.pick.reason: inside the real Bible view, open only after bible.translation; checked in apps/bible/view/tests/fleet-map.bible.spec.ts

bible.search.open.reason: inside the real Bible view; checked in apps/bible/view/tests/fleet-map.bible.spec.ts

bible.search.box.reason: inside the real Bible view, open only after bible.search.open; checked in apps/bible/view/tests/fleet-map.bible.spec.ts

bible.search.results.reason: inside the real Bible view, open only after bible.search.open; checked in apps/bible/view/tests/fleet-map.bible.spec.ts

bible.search.count.note: <n> verses in <abbreviation>, once there are hits
bible.search.count.reason: inside the real Bible view, shown only after a search with hits; checked in apps/bible/view/tests/fleet-map.bible.spec.ts

bible.search.empty.note: the line for a search with no hits
bible.search.empty.reason: inside the real Bible view, shown only after a search with no hits; checked in apps/bible/view/tests/fleet-map.bible.spec.ts

bible.search.goref.note: Go to <reference>, when what's searched is a reference
bible.search.goref.reason: inside the real Bible view, shown only after a search that reads as a reference; checked in apps/bible/view/tests/fleet-map.bible.spec.ts

bible.search.all.note: offered when this translation has no hits
bible.search.all.reason: inside the real Bible view, shown only after a search with no hits; checked in apps/bible/view/tests/fleet-map.bible.spec.ts

bible.search.hit.reason: inside the real Bible view, shown only after a search with hits; checked in apps/bible/view/tests/fleet-map.bible.spec.ts

bible.search.hit.ref.note: a hit's reference, such as John 3:16 (inside bible.search.hit)
bible.search.hit.ref.reason: inside the real Bible view, shown only after a search with hits; checked in apps/bible/view/tests/fleet-map.bible.spec.ts

bible.search.hit.text.reason: inside the real Bible view, shown only after a search with hits; checked in apps/bible/view/tests/fleet-map.bible.spec.ts

bible.verse.note: a verse, or a part of one (a list); its data-v is the verse's number
bible.verse.reason: inside the real Bible view; checked in apps/bible/view/tests/fleet-map.bible.spec.ts

bible.verse.text.note: a verse's words (inside bible.verse); a press selects the verse; a highlight adds hl-<color>
bible.verse.text.reason: inside the real Bible view; checked in apps/bible/view/tests/fleet-map.bible.spec.ts

bible.versebar.reason: inside the real Bible view, shown only with a verse selected; checked in apps/bible/view/tests/fleet-map.bible.spec.ts

bible.color.note: one highlight color (a list, inside bible.versebar); its data-c is the color
bible.color.reason: inside the real Bible view, shown only with a verse selected; checked in apps/bible/view/tests/fleet-map.bible.spec.ts

office.shell.note: the signed-in office (shell/Shell.tsx; what the office's own specs wait on); the Desks landmark inside it has no height of its own

office.notice.note: the office's one notice when there are no desks to show (chrome/CalmScreen.tsx): its text says why

office.desk.note: a desk's button (a list, a11y/ProxyLayer.tsx): id proxy-<deskId>, name <Name> desk, <n> apps, <status> (desk/agentStatus.ts); pressing it brings the desk to the front and wakes it; m moves, r resizes, . its menu; its style's left, top, width and height are the desk's in world units

office.desk.kind.note: each desk's button (the same ones as office.desk) with its id and kind, from the office's own desk list (state/deskStore.ts, DeskInfo): data-desk <deskId> (a Guild Desk's guild-<guildId>); data-kind is one of four values: personal, work, guild, custom (DeskKind)

office.tile.note: an app's tile on a desk (a list): id proxy-<deskId>:<app>, name <App>[, <problem>][, <n> unread]; style left, top, width and height in world units, the desk's own (office.desk) included; m moves, r resizes, . its menu

office.home.note: the home mark, a button only while a desk is in front and more than one is in scope (chrome/TopBar.tsx)

office.desknav.note: the bottom bar's desk switch: the active desk's name, then <i> of <n>; only with more than one desk

office.window.note: an app's window (a list, windows/AppWindow.tsx): data-desk, data-app; a parked one (an unseen desk's) is display none

office.window.close.note: Close <App>, in a window's head (inside office.window)

office.opentile.note: a tile at the open size that's live (a list, opentile/OpenTileLayer.tsx): data-desk, data-item, data-app

office.menu.desk.note: the desk's menu: . on its button (chrome/DeskMenu.tsx)

office.menu.apps.note: Apps, in the desk's menu, where the desk takes apps

office.apps.empty.note: the sheet's one line instead of rows: data-state asleep, connecting, off, failed, loading or none; its text is the sheet's words

office.apps.row.note: one app (a list, inside office.apps.sheet): data-testid dapp-row-<id>, data-installed yes or no

office.apps.add.note: Add to desk (inside office.apps.row); Adding… while it goes

office.apps.open.note: Open, once it's on the desk (inside office.apps.row)

office.apps.remove.note: Remove (inside office.apps.row); Removing… while it goes

office.apps.line.note: a row's line after a refusal (inside office.apps.row)
office.apps.line.reason: shows only after the desk refuses an add or a remove, which the map check doesn't make

office.account.note: the account button in the top bar (chrome/AccountMenu.tsx)

office.account.dialog.note: the account panel, open after office.account

office.theme.note: the Theme radios (inside office.account.dialog); the chosen one is aria-checked

office.browser.address.note: the Browser's address field (browser/BrowserBar.tsx, inside its office.window); Enter goes

office.browser.video.note: the desk's picture of the page; playing once its videoWidth is over 0

office.browser.tab.note: one tab on the desk (a list); the active one has class active

office.browser.tab.title.note: a tab's title button (inside office.browser.tab); aria-current on the active one

office.browser.simple.note: Simplified, a radio in the bar (simple/BarSwitch.tsx); aria-checked while the page is simplified

office.browser.panel.note: the panel over the picture while the Browser starts, the desk sleeps or the picture can't show: data-panel says which
office.browser.panel.reason: shows only while there's no picture; the harness's mock desk plays at once

apps.desk.note: each desk's own button in the canvas's accessible mirror (src/a11y/ProxyLayer.tsx): its id is proxy-<deskId>, a Guild Desk's proxy-guild-<guildId>, and its name '<Name> desk, N apps, <status>'

apps.live.note: the office's polite live region, what a screen reader hears: Files says '<folder>, N items' there once a folder has loaded (src/a11y/LiveRegion.tsx)

apps.deskGroup.note: each desk's group, '<Name> desk', holding its button and its tiles' buttons (ProxyLayer.tsx)
apps.deskGroup.reason: a wrapper with no box of its own (its buttons are placed absolutely), so never visible itself: the tools find a desk's by its apps.desk button inside, and the map check scopes the tiles to it

notebook.tile.note: a desk's Notebook tile, inside its apps.deskGroup

notebook.view.note: the Notebook on screen, in a window or an open tile (src/windows/AppWindow.tsx, LiveWindow.tsx); data-desk is its desk

notebook.app.note: the Notebook itself, once its desk answers (web/notebook/src/ui/Notebook.tsx)

notebook.panel.note: what's in the way instead of the Notebook: a desk asleep, waking or unreachable (src/notebook/NotebookApp.tsx)
notebook.panel.reason: shows only while the desk can't answer; the harness's desks answer at once

notebook.editor.note: the page's text, ProseMirror's editor; its first line with text is the page's title (web/notebook/src/ui/Editor.tsx)

notebook.newPage.note: New page, in the page list (TabView.tsx)

notebook.page.note: each page in the list; aria-current on the open one, data-page-id its id (TabView.tsx)

notebook.tab.note: each tab of the open notebook, aria-selected on the open one, inside the tablist 'Tabs in <notebook>' (TabView.tsx)

notebook.line.note: the line under the Notebook when something isn't saved yet or the desk isn't there (NotebookApp.tsx)
notebook.line.reason: shows only while what was typed hasn't reached the desk

notebook.notice.note: a line in the page list saying why something didn't work (a page that couldn't be made, a space the member can't change) (TabView.tsx)
notebook.notice.reason: only after the desk refused something

files.tile.note: a desk's Files tile, inside its apps.deskGroup (shown while client-config's files block is on)

files.view.note: Files on screen, in a window or an open tile; data-desk is its desk

files.unsupported.note: the one line a desk that can't do Files shows
files.unsupported.reason: only on a desk without Files (an older deskd, or a guild's)

files.empty.note: the line an empty folder shows instead of the list
files.empty.reason: only in an empty folder; the mock desk's top folder has files

files.row.note: each row, with data-name and data-type (file or dir)

files.row.size.note: a row's size, empty for a folder

files.crumb.note: each step of the folder path 'Files / a / b'; the last is the folder open now

files.actions.note: the toolbar: Upload files, New folder, then Download, Rename, Move to… and Delete for a selection

files.upload.note: Upload files, which opens the browser's file chooser

files.xfer.note: each transfer in the tray, data-name its file and data-state where it is (done, failed, rejected or cancelled once over) (Tray.tsx)
files.xfer.reason: only once something is uploading or downloading

files.xfer.words.note: what a transfer says, inside files.xfer
files.xfer.words.reason: only once something is uploading or downloading

files.delete.note: Delete, shown once a row is selected: to the Trash, which keeps it 30 days

files.backToFiles.note: back to the folders from the Trash or a search
files.backToFiles.reason: only in the Trash or a search

files.nameDialog.note: the dialog New folder and Rename open (Dialogs.tsx)

files.nameDialog.error.note: why a name can't be used, inside files.nameDialog (empty until then)

files.notice.note: a line about what didn't work (an upload refused, a folder to drop into)

files.usage.note: how much of the drive is used, '1.4 GB of 25 GB used'

maia.widget.note: Maia's corner, shown only where client-config has a maia block and her state says enabled (src/maia/MaiaWidget.tsx)

maia.launcher.note: her bubble, which opens and hides her panel

maia.panel.note: her panel, a dialog titled by maia.title

maia.title.note: which view the panel shows: 'Maia' (the chat), 'Your chats' or 'What Maia remembers'

maia.send.note: Send; aria-disabled=false once she's done answering

maia.item.note: each thing in the chat, in order: the member's message (.maia-me), hers (.maia-her) and her notices (.maia-note)

maia.hers.note: each of her messages, the one being written included

maia.busy.note: her message while she's still writing it

maia.stop.note: why she stopped (a refusal, a limit), inside a maia.hers

maia.card.note: a suggestion she makes, inside a maia.hers: its name is its title, data-action its kind (src/maia/Card.tsx)

maia.note.note: a notice in the chat, such as the model changing or free Maia

maia.free.note: 'Free Maia until …', above the composer while she answers on her free model
maia.free.reason: only past the member's Maia allowance

maia.newChat.note: New chat, in the chat view; disabled while the chat is empty or she's answering

maia.chatsButton.note: Your chats, in the chat view

maia.back.note: back to the chat, from Your chats or What Maia remembers

maia.chat.note: each chat in Your chats; aria-current on the one open now

maia.intro.note: 'Loading…', or the words Your chats shows when there are none

maia.line.note: a status line in her panel, such as a chat that couldn't load or a message that couldn't go

commons.tile.note: a Guild Desk's Commons tile, inside its apps.deskGroup

commons.view.note: Commons on screen, in a window or an open tile; data-desk is the Guild Desk's panel, guild-<guildId>

commons.app.note: the room itself, once the Guild Desk answers (src/guild/CommonsBody.tsx)

commons.panel.note: what's in the way instead of the room: a Guild Desk waking or asleep (src/guild/CommonsWindow.tsx)
commons.panel.reason: shows only while the Guild Desk can't answer; the harness's is running

commons.showChannels.note: brings the channel list back after Hide channels (apps/commons/web/src/ui/Commons.tsx)
commons.showChannels.reason: only after the member hid the channels

commons.showChat.note: brings the chat back after Hide chat
commons.showChat.reason: only after the member hid the chat

commons.channel.note: each channel in 'Channels': data-here=1 on the one open, data-unread=1 on one with unread messages (ui/Channels.tsx)

commons.channel.open.note: the button that opens a channel, inside commons.channel

commons.chat.title.note: the channel the chat is for (ui/Chat.tsx)

commons.chat.note: the channel's chat thread, inside commons.app

commons.chat.loaded.note: the thread's top: 'This is the start of #<channel>', or Earlier messages; shows once the thread has loaded

commons.msg.note: each message; data-pending=1 until the Guild Desk numbers it, data-head=1 where a name shows above it

commons.msg.name.note: who wrote it, inside a commons.msg that heads a group

commons.msg.time.note: when, inside a commons.msg that heads a group: its datetime is the ISO time
